Downtown Skyscraper Visualisation

Andy CASA, UCL East


Dreamsoft 3D Skyskraper Demo from ray hubbard on Vimeo.


The movie above is, in their own words, a demo '3D animation of a Downtown scene with Sky Skraper by Dreamsoft'.

Note the misspelling of Scraper, we thought perhaps its a new software package but looking at the Dreamsoft site we cant find any mention of it, although the movie has only been online for a day so perhaps an announcement is planned?

Either way its an interesting movie and if we get any news on its construction we will let you know..
